messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
నేను దిగువ స్థలానికి తిరిగి పడుతున్నప్పుడు, నా కళ్ల ముందు ఒకరు కనిపించారు దీర్ఘ నిశ్శబ్దం ద్వారా అతను బలహీనంగా అనిపించాడు.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Telugu)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Telugu) | Back‑Translation (Eng) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | Mentre | temporal conjunction “while” | **పడుతున్నప్పుడు** | “while (falling)” | OK | | ch'i' | contraction of “che io” – “that I / while I” (subject = I) | **నేను** | “I” | OK | | rovinava | imperfect “was falling / going down” | **పడుతున్న** | “was falling” | OK | | in | preposition of direction “to, into” | **కు** | “to” | OK | | basso | adjective “low, low‑lying” | **దిగువ** | “low” | OK | | loco | noun “place, location” (dative) | **స్థలానికి** | “to the place” | OK | | dinanzi | adverb/preposition “before, in front of” | **ముందు** | “before / in front of” | OK | | a | preposition linking “dinanzi a” (to) – not needed in Telugu | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | li | definite article “the” (plural) – Telugu has no articles | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | occhi | noun “eyes” (possessive) | **కళ్ల** | “eyes” | OK | | mi | 1st‑sg dative “to me / my” (experiencer) | **నా** | “my” | OK | | si | reflexive/impersonal pronoun in passive construction | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | fu | auxiliary verb “was” (remote past) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | offerto | past participle “offered, presented” | **కనిపించారు** | “appeared / was seen” | OK | | chi | relative pronoun “who, that” | **అతను** | “he / that one” | OK | | per | preposition “through, by means of” | **ద్వారా** | “through” | OK | | lungo | adjective “long” | **దీర్ఘ** | “long” | OK | | silenzio | noun “silence” | **నిశ్శబ్దం** | “silence” | OK | | parea | imperfect “seemed, appeared” | **అనిపించాడు** | “seemed” | OK | | fioco | adjective “hoarse, weak, faint” | **బలహీనంగా** | “weakly / faintly” | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `a`, `li`, `si`, `fu` – these function words are not required in Telugu and were omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; all retained lexical items convey the intended meaning and agree in gender/number with Telugu grammar.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 61: - Original: నేను దిగువ స్థలానికి తిరిగి పడుతున్నప్పుడు, - Issue: none - Corrected: నేను దిగువ స్థలానికి తిరిగి పడుతున్నప్పుడు, - Line 62: - Original: నా కళ్ల ముందు ఒకరు కనిపించారు - Issue: GRAMMAR – verb agreement (plural form) - Corrected: నా కళ్ల ముందు ఒకరు కనిపించాడు - Line 63: - Original: దీర్ఘ నిశ్శబ్దం ద్వారా అతను బలహీనంగా అనిపించాడు. - Issue: none - Corrected: దీర్ఘ నిశ్శబ్దం ద్వారా అతను బలహీనంగా అనిపించాడు.
